# Digital Photo Mentor

> Digital Photo Mentor is a comprehensive photography education platform offering courses, workshops, and photo tours for photographers of all skill levels.

Founded by Darlene Hildebrandt, Digital Photo Mentor provides hands-on training through online courses, in-person workshops across North America, and expert-led photo tours to international destinations. The platform specializes in photography fundamentals, advanced editing techniques with tools like Luminar Neo, and immersive travel photography experiences.

## Key Topics

- Photography Basics
- Camera Techniques
- Photo Editing
- Luminar Neo
- Hands-On Training
- Beginner-Friendly
- Photography Education
- Darlene Hildebrandt
- Photo Tours

- Travel Photography

## Core Platform

- [Digital Photo Mentor - Take Better Photos and Master Your Editing](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com): Homepage introducing Digital Photo Mentor's photography education and editing courses
- [About Darlene Hildebrandt and Digital Photo Mentor](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/about-darlene): Founder Darlene Hildebrandt's bio and photography credentials and expertise

## Photo Tours & Workshops

- [Photo Tours for 2026 and 2027 | Japan, Morocco, Peru, Vietnam](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/photo-tours): Expert-led photo tours to Japan, Morocco, Peru and Vietnam for travel photographers
- [Photography Workshops in Canada, Mexico and Cuba for All Skill Levels](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/workshops): Hands-on photography workshops across Canada, Mexico and Cuba for all levels
- [Night Photography Workshop | Alberta | Digital Photo Mentor](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/workshops/night-photography): Four-day night photography workshop in Central Alberta with starlit skies

## Online Courses & Education

- [Luminar Neo Course 2025: Edit Like a Pro, Step-by-Step](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/luminar-neo-course): 28+ hours Luminar Neo editing course with lifetime access and 4K lessons
- [Photography Basics for Beginners - Camera Settings & Tips | Free Course](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/photography-basics): Free beginner course covering camera settings, ISO, exposure and fundamentals
- [Photography Basics for Beginners](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/photography-basics/beginners): Email course and tutorial series for beginner photography fundamentals

## Learning Resources

- [10 Photography Challenges - Digital Photo Mentor](https://www.digitalphotomentor.com/10-photography-challenges): Free ebook with 10 practical photography exercises for skill building
